prerequisites: Financial accounting and balance sheet accounting at bachelor level
Materials management and PPS at bachelor level

learning_outcomes.text: Students know the methods for determining the costs for development projects and in calculation and production planning and control, and know how costs are influenced. They know different cost accounting systems and can interpret cost information.
Students know the most important and current cost accounting systems and can determine cost information themselves and derive appropriate measures to influence costs.

Students know the essential cost accounting methods, such as marginal costing and contribution accounting, process cost accounting, and can apply the cost accounting systems. They know the common concepts of business standard software systems and can decide on and implement the use of procedures within them.

Students can design and customize cost and controlling systems for their area with an Enterprise Resource Planning system. They recognize the connection between the systems of calculation, materials management and cost management, as well as the procedures used there. They can understand and explain the influence of cost information on the financial and earnings situation of companies.

Students can determine and justify the costs incurred in their area and trace deviations back to their causes and explain them. They can also interpret the costs with regard to different cost accounting systems and know the possibilities of influence of product design and production on costs. They can communicate with experts and laypersons about the use and method of cost accounting systems.

syllabus_topics: ERP system SAP R/3 in CO (and related areas MM, PP and FI)
Annual financial statement-related and internal reporting
assessment_rules: The graded examination is a written exam. The duration and scope of the exam are specified in the respective valid study regulations.
